card.name: Last digit of years in citations
card.fires_on: The final digit of a four-digit publication year (like 200_ or 201_) in a journal reference, and sometimes the separator right after the year.

modes.label: Year's last digit
modes.description: The last digit of a year in the 1990s to 2010s inside a reference list entry.
modes.example: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews 201<<1>>, Issue 2.

modes.label: Punctuation after year
modes.description: The semicolon right after a complete year in a journal citation.
modes.example: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society, 2010<<;>> DOI: 10.10
